{{Term/Store|Old Man|Old Men|Series, TLoZ, TAoL, OoS, OoA, FSA, BotW|plural}} are recurring characters in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 219 {{Exp Game|TLoZ}} & 223 {{Exp Game|TAoL}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= A&A |publisher= |page= 209 {{Exp Game|OoS, OoA}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 265 & 266 {{Exp Game|FSA}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Old Man|Game Screen|BotW}}</ref>

==Biography==
==={{TLoZ|-}}===
{{Main|Sword-Giving Old Man, White Sword-Giving Old Man, Magical Sword-Giving Old Man, Letter-Entrusting Old Man}}
[[File:TLoZ Old Man Misc. Quote 1.png|thumb|left|x120px|An Old Man giving Link a 2nd Potion or a Heart Container from {{TLoZ|-}}]]
In {{TLoZ}}, there are several Old Men across [[Hyrule]], each serving various needs, such as supplying [[Link]] with his first [[Sword]],<ref>{{Cite|IT'S DANGEROUS TO GO ALONE! TAKE THIS.|Old Man|TLoZ}}</ref> or giving helpful advice regarding enemies such as the [[Dodongo]].<ref>{{Cite|DODONGO DISLIKES SMOKE.|Old Man|TLoZ}}</ref> Many helpful items can be obtained from these old men, and a mini-game can be played with them called the [[Money Making Game]].<ref>{{Cite|LET'S PLAY A MONEY-MAKING GAME.|Old Man|TLoZ}}</ref> If he is found in dungeons and is stabbed, the [[Torch]]es around him will fire energy blasts at Link, similar to those of a [[Stone Statue]].

Link can receive the [[Letter]] from the [[Letter-Entrusting Old Man]] in a northeast cave of Hyrule.<ref>{{Cite|SHOW THIS TO THE OLD WOMAN.|Old Man|TLoZ}}</ref> When Link shows the Letter to various [[Old Woman|Old Women]], they will sell him [[Life Potion]]s and [[Red Water of Life|2nd Potion]]s.<ref>{{Cite|BUY MEDICINE BEFORE YOU GO.|Old Woman|TLoZ}}</ref>

An Old Man is present in each [[Warp Hall]]. They inform Link of the area's function, transportation.<ref>{{Cite|TAKE ANY ROAD YOU WANT.|Old Man|TLoZ}}</ref>

==={{TAoL|-}}===
In {{TAoL}}, one Old Man resides in each town.<ref name=WiseOldMan>{{Cite|EACH TOWN HAS A WISE MAN. LEARN FROM HIM.|Hylian|TAoL}}</ref> They teach Link useful [[Magic of The Adventure of Link|Magic]] once he has achieved the necessary prerequisites.<ref>{{Cite|IN PARAPA DESERT USE THIS MAGIC TO SURVIVE|Old Man|TAoL}}</ref> These magical abilities are usually required for access to the next area that Link must travel to.

==={{OoS|-}}===
[[File:OOS OldManCave.png|thumb|left|x120px|The secret home of the Old Man from {{OoS|-}}]]
In {{OoS}}, Old Men appear in [[Cave]]s that Link finds using by using the [[Shovel]] or  burning [[Sapling]]s using [[Ember Seed]]s. Some bribe Link not to tell anybody about their secret caves by giving him a large sum of approximately 300 [[Rupee]]s. Others will thank Link, and charge him a large sum of money in order to repair their doors. 

There are three special Old Men in Holodrum who differ from the rest. The first (and only required one) lives in a house in [[Holodrum Plain]], accessible after getting the [[Flippers]]. At first, the Old Man will only mutter to himself about someone he is waiting for.<ref>{{Cite|Soil, time, sun, rain, warmth... I await one who knows many essences...|Old Man|OoS}}</ref> After getting the first five [[Essence of Nature|Essences of Nature]], Link must visit and speak to him once more to receive the [[Round Jewel]].

The second is the [[Golden Sage]] living in a cave on the bottom of the river just below the [[Gnarled Root Dungeon]], only accessible in Summer. At first, he will simply instruct Link to find and slay all four [[Golden Monster]]s; once Link has done so, he will reward him with the [[Red Ring]].

The last one can be found in a hidden underground cavern behind the [[Clock Shop]] after beating a non-Linked game. This Old Man asks for a [[Secret]], and if this secret is retrieved from a linked {{OoA}} game and given to him, he will upgrade Link's [[Noble Sword]] to the Master Sword (or his [[Wooden Sword]] to the Noble Sword, if applicable).

In a [[Linked Game|linked version]] of the game, another Old Man can be found inside the [[Hero's Cave]].

==={{OoA|-}}===
Only one Old Man cave is present in {{OoA|-}} and is found in [[Rolling Ridge Base]]. In the past it is inhabited by a generous Old Man, who would give Link 200 Rupees. On the opposite, the Old Man inhabiting it in the present would charge him 50 Rupees to repair the door.

==={{FSA|-}}===
{{Stub|FSA}}
There are multiple Old Men in {{FSA}}.

One Old Man appears in the [[Village of the Blue Maiden]].

Another Old Man appears in [[Kakariko Village (Stage)|Kakariko Village]]. He has lost the wife with whom he has been married for 56 years,<ref name="Letter">{{Cite|Dearest, we've been married now for 56 years, and you've always been so good to me. After I'm gone, please don't let yourself be too sad for too long. If you get lonely, get yourself a cute Cucco as a pet. If you do, perhaps you'll be able to forget some of your sorrow. Good-bye, old timer. We'll meet again one day.|Letter|FSA}}</ref> and now he feels lonely.<ref>{{Cite|... ... ... ... ... Darling... what will I ever do without you...|Old Man|FSA}}</ref> His wife wrote a [[Letter]] recommending him to get a cute [[Cucco]] as a pet.<ref name="Letter"/> If the [[Links]] give him a Cucco, the Old Timer rewards them with a [[Key]],<ref name="Passed On">{{Cite|... ... ... ... ... Ah, what an adorable Cucco. It warms my old heart. After my wife passed on, I was prepared to spend the rest of my days alone... But now that I've seen that Cucco... Would you... let me take care of it for you? I'll give you this key, and you can even take as many Force Gems as you like. If I have that Cucco by my side, I won't need anything else.|Old Man|FSA}}</ref> allowing the young heroes to access a room in his house where they can find the [[Power Bracelet]], and tells them to take as many [[Force Gem]]s as they would like.<ref name="Passed On"/>
{{Clear}}

==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Main|King Rhoam}}
[[File:BotW Old Man.png|thumb|left|250px|Link meeting the Old Man from {{BotW|-}}]]
In {{BotW}}, an Old Man lives on the [[Great Plateau]]. Though he can be found throughout the Plateau, he resides in the [[Old Man's Cabin]] on its southeastern side. The Old Man is a persona taken on by [[King Rhoam]], the former king of [[Hyrule]], in order to avoid overwhelming [[Link]] after his [[Slumber of Restoration]].<ref>{{Cite|I did not think it wise to overwhelm you while your memory was still fragile. So rather than that, I thought it best to assume a temporary form.|King Rhoam|BotW}}</ref> In this form, he gives Link advice that varies based on his location.

After Link exits the [[Shrine of Resurrection]], the Old Man will be in a small alcove nearby. He sits by a [[Campfire]], which is surrounded by a [[Torch]] and [[Baked Apple]]s. When Link approaches him, the Old Man greets him, commenting that it is strange to see someone else on the Great Plateau.<ref>{{Cite|Oho ho! Well met, stranger! It's rather unusual to see another soul in these parts.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link asks who he is, the Old Man claims to be a hermit who lives by himself on the Plateau, and he wonders what could bring someone so young to such a place.<ref>{{Cite|[Who are you?] Me? I'll spare you my life story. I'm just an old fool who has lived here, alone, for quite some time now. What brings a bright-eyed young man like you to a place like this?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Link can then ask where they are, and the Old Man reveals that they are on the Great Plateau, which is rumored to be the birthplace of Hyrule.<ref>{{Cite|[Where are we?] Answering a question with a question. That is fair enough. As I cannot imagine our meeting to be a simple coincidence...I shall tell you. This is the {{Color BotW|Blue|Great Plateau}}. According to legend, this is the birthplace of the entire kingdom of Hyrule.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He then points out the ruined [[Temple of Time]], which he compares to a ghost of its former self.<ref>{{Cite|That temple there... Long ago, that was the site of many sacred ceremonies. Ever since the decline of the kingdom 100 years ago, it has sat abandoned, in a state of decay. Yet another forgotten entity. A mere ghost of its former self...|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> The Old Man claims he will be at his Campfire for some time, and he tells Link to let him know if he needs help.<ref>{{Cite|I shall be here for some time. Please let me know if I may be of service.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

If Link interacts with the Old Man and tries to leave, he will insist that Link take a moment to talk with him.<ref>{{Cite|[Bye.] Wait. Where are you rushing off to now? Is speaking with a strange old man truly such an awful use of your time?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link insists on leaving, the Old Man will let him go.<ref>{{Cite|[Bye.] Hmph. Well, do as you like, then.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He will also comment on Link's silence.<ref>{{Cite|Oho ho! So you fancy yourself the strong silent type, eh?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Should Link end their conversation, the Old Man asks if there is somewhere he needs to be.<ref>{{Cite|[Bye.] Do you not have somewhere else to be, young one?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

When Link speaks to the Old Man again, he can ask what he is doing. The Old Man reveals that he is relaxing by his Campfire, though he plans on [[Cooking]] another Baked Apple.<ref>{{Cite|[What are you doing?] I'm relaxing by the fireside, of course. Although I'll need to cook myself another baked apple at some point...|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Though they can be eaten raw, he explains to Link that Cooking them makes them more nutritious.<ref>{{Cite|Simple foods such as apples are fine to eat raw, but roasting them on a fire makes them tastier and more nutritious.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link takes one of the Old Man's Baked Apples, he will initially be angry at him for picking it up without permission.<ref>{{Cite|I BEG YOUR PARDON! I do believe that is my baked apple! You can't just go about taking whatever you please!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> However, the Old Man reveals this to be a joke and allows Link to have it.<ref>{{Cite|Oho ho! Forgive me—I could not resist pulling your leg. Please help yourself.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

When Link picks up the Torch nearby, the Old Man asks what he intends to use it for.<ref>{{Cite|Well then, just help yourself to that torch there. And how, may I ask, are you planning to use it?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link replies that he plans to use it as a [[Weapon]], the Old Man will advise him to take the [[Woodcutter's Axe]] in the nearby [[Tree Stump]] instead.<ref>{{Cite|[As a weapon!] Innovative... However, that is probably best used to light fires. If you need a weapon, you can find something better. Many beasts roam the land past this point. You can take my axe with you, if you please. Assuming you can find it.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link tells him he plans to use it to light [[Fire]]s, the Old Man will be concerned, but he tells Link to be careful.<ref>{{Cite|[To set things on fire!] That is rather...unnerving. Please be cautious with that around any dry grass that might catch fire.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Finally, if Link refuses to tell him, the Old Man decides not to pry.<ref>{{Cite|[It's a secret...] I see, Well then, do as you please.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> After the latter two choices, the Old Man claims that the Torch could be used as a Weapon against [[Monster]]s.<ref>{{Cite|You know, there are plenty of monsters in this area. That torch would make a good weapon, if need be.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> However, he warns Link not to swing it randomly, and he should focus on targeting his [[Enemy|Enemies]].<ref>{{Cite|However, do not just swing it around without purpose. You must face your opponents and lock your sights on them!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

[[File:BotW Old Man Paragliding.png|thumb|right|250px|The Old Man using the Paraglider]]
After Link descends from the top of the [[Great Plateau Tower]], the Old Man glides to him with the [[Paraglider]]. He informs Link that that [[Sheikah Tower]]s have simultaneously risen across Hyrule, and he asks if anything happened while Link was on top of the Tower.<ref>{{Cite|My my... It would seem that we have quite the enigma here. This tower and several others just like it have erupted across the land, one after another. Very interesting... It is almost as though...a long-dormant power has awoken quite suddenly. Did anything...odd occur while you were atop that tower?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link claims to have heard a voice, the Old Man wonders if he recognized it.<ref>{{Cite|[I heard a voice.] Well now! A voice, you say? And did you happen to recognize this mysterious voice?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link admits that he did not, the Old Man will be disappointed.<ref>{{Cite|[No.] I see. Well, then...that is a shame.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He then points out [[Calamity Ganon]], which is circling [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]].<ref>{{Cite|I assume that you caught sight of that atrocity enshrouding the castle. That...is {{Color BotW|Red|Calamity Ganon}}.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He recounts that one century prior, it brought ruin to Hyrule before eventually being sealed within the Castle.<ref>{{Cite|One hundred years ago, that vile entity brought the kingdom of {{Color BotW|Blue|Hyrule}} to ruin. It appeared suddenly and destroyed everything in its path. So many innocent lives were lost in its wake. For a century, the very symbol of our kingdom, Hyrule Castle, has managed to contain that evil.. But just barely.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

According to the Old Man, Calamity Ganon will soon regain its strength and break free from its seal, and he asks Link if he plans to go to the Castle.<ref>{{Cite|There it festers, building its strength for the moment it will unleash its blight upon the land once again. It would appear that moment is fast approaching... I must ask you, courageous one... Do you intend to make your way to the castle?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link confirms that he does, the Old Man informs him that there is no way down from the Great Plateau, since it is surrounded by cliffs on all sides.<ref>{{Cite|[I do.] I had a feeling you would say that. Here, on this isolated plateau, we are surrounded on all sides by steep cliffs, with no way down. If you were to try to jump off, well... no death could be more certain. Or more foolish.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> However, the Old Man's Paraglider would allow one to leave the Plateau without falling.<ref>{{Cite|Of course, if you had a paraglider like mine, that would be quite another story.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> When Link shows interest in the Paraglider, the Old Man offers to give it to him, but only if Link can offer something else in return.<ref>{{Cite|[Hand it over!] Oho! Certainly! Why not? But there is no such thing as a free item in this world, you know.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|[Paraglider?] Oho! Piqued your interest, have I? Yes, I didn't come soaring down here on my own feathery wings, you know! Worry not—I will happily agree to five you my paraglider. But not for nothing.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He then suggests that Link retrieve a treasure that can be found nearby.<ref>{{Cite|Let's see now... How about I trade it for a bit of treasure that slumbers nearby?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> After this, "[[The Isolated Plateau]]" [[Main Quest]] will begin.

The Old Man tells Link to follow him as he walks towards the edge of the hill.<ref>{{Cite|Come. Let me show you something.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He points out [[Oman Au Shrine]], which began glowing once the Sheikah Towers emerged.<ref>{{Cite|Do you see that structure there? The one shining with a strange light? It began glowing at the exact moment those towers rose up from the ground.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> The Old Man reasons that there must be a treasure inside the [[Ancient Shrine]], and if Link brings it to him, he promises to give him the Paraglider in return.<ref>{{Cite|I would think such a place might house some sort of treasure, wouldn't you? Treasure for the {{Color BotW|Blue|paraglider}}. A fair exchange, I believe.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link speaks to the Old Man again, he tells him to retrieve any treasure he can find in the Ancient Shrine.<ref>{{Cite|Go on! Fetch me any treasure you find inside that shrine. I am looking forward to your successful return.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

After Link completes his first Ancient Shrine, the Old Man glides towards him with the Paraglider once again. He congratulates Link for obtaining a [[Spirit Orb]].<ref>{{Cite|It seems you managed to get your hands on a {{Color BotW|Blue|Spirit Orb}}. Well done!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link asks how he knew, the Old Man attributes it to clairvoyance.<ref>{{Cite|[How did you know?!] {{Big|Clairvoyance!}} Oho, or perhaps something similar.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He goes on to explain that as one gets older, it becomes more difficult to see what is right in front of them, but they may be able to see things that were once hidden from view.<ref>{{Cite|As one gets old, it can become more difficult to see what is right before one's own eyes... However, that which was once hidden from view can often be crystal clear. But perhaps that is not true for everyone! Oho ho!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

The Old Man then claims that the Sheikah Towers and Ancient Shrines activating is a result of the [[Sheikah Slate]].<ref>{{Cite|The appearance of those towers and the awakening of this shrine... It is all connected to that {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}} you carry on your hip there.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link asks what he means, the Old Man states that the [[Sheikah]] used their [[Ancient Technology]] to save Hyrule, but it disappeared a long time ago.<ref>{{Cite|[What do you mean?] It has been quite some time since I have seen that {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}}... Long ago, a highly advanced tribe known as the Sheikah inhabited these lands. The great power of their wisdom saved this kingdom time and time again. But their ancient technology disappeared long ago... Or so it is said.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He is intrigued that the Sheikah Slate was hidden away for so long.<ref>{{Cite|It is interesting, however, to think... how something like that survived all this time, hidden away in a shrine.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

The Old Man reveals that Ancient Shrines can be found all throughout Hyrule, and if Link brings him the Spirit Orbs from the four on the Great Plateau, he will give him his Paraglider.<ref>{{Cite|These shrines are tucked away in numerous places all across this land. On this plateau alone, I believe there are still {{Color BotW|Red|three}} more. Bring me the treasure from each of those shrines...and I will give you my {{Color BotW|Blue|paraglider}}.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link argues this was not their original deal, the Old Man claims that he changed his mind.<ref>{{Cite|[That wasn't the deal!] Oh? Well, I suppose I changed my mind. I'm sure that won't be a problem for a young go-getter like you!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link clarifies that he needs more Spirit Orbs, the Old Man recalls that he never said he needed only one treasure.<ref>{{Cite|[So I need more now?] I said "treasure," but I never said there would only be one treasure. Whether it's one treasure or four, what's the difference for a young go-getter like yourself?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

To help Link, the Old Man tells him to scout for Ancient Shrines from a high point, suggesting that he return to the top of the Great Plateau Tower.<ref>{{Cite|Since I'm feeling generous, I will also teach you a trick for finding shrines. It's always best to survey the area by {{Color BotW|Red|looking around from a high point}}. Let's see here... How about you make your way to the top of that tower again?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link asks if he is joking, the Old Man confirms that he is not, but he also has another trick to help him.<ref>{{Cite|[Are you joking?] Oho ho! I am afraid not. But do not worry! I have another little trick to share with you for your effort.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He reveals that if Link opens the [[Map]] on his Sheikah Slate, he will be able to [[Warping|Warp]] to any [[Travel Gate]] he has already activated.<ref>{{Cite|Take a look at the {{Color BotW|Blue|map}} on your {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}}. See those {{Color BotW|Blue|blue icons}}? You should recognize the cave where you woke, the shrine you came from, and the tower. You can travel instantly to any of those places with the {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}}.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> However, he claims he heard this a long time ago, and he does not know if this actually works.<ref>{{Cite|Or so I heard quite some time ago... I do not know if it actually works as such.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

If Link speaks to the Old Man again, he tells him to search for Ancient Shrines from the top of the Great Plateau Tower.<ref>{{Cite|Try traveling to the top of the tower. From there, you should be able to scout the location of another shrine.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Should Link comment on how much the Old Man knows, he explains that his knowledge comes from his age.<ref>{{Cite|[You sure know a lot...] Oho ho! When you have been around as long as I have, you pick up a thing or two. Go on, why not try it out?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

When Link returns to the top of the Great Plateau Tower, the Old Man will already be there. He is surprised that Link took so long to reach the Tower.<ref>{{Cite|I'm surprised it took you so long to catch up with an old man like me!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Though Link is confused how he made it up there so quickly, the Old Man refuses to share his secrets.<ref>{{Cite|Oho ho! Leave an old man to his secrets.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He repeats that he wanted Link to search for Ancient Shrines from the top of the Tower,<ref>{{Cite|Now then... I wanted you to join me up here so you could use this as a vantage point to search for shrines.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> revealing that Link can use the [[Scope]] of his Sheikah Slate to stick [[Pin]]s to the Map.<ref name="Scope">{{Cite|Did you know about the {{Color BotW|Blue|scope}} on your {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}}? Look through it, and you can stick a pin anywhere you'd like to mark on the map. The pins on your {{Color BotW|Blue|map}} serve as reference points for your travels. Just stick a pin anywhere you're interested in!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He then explains that Pins can serve as reference points while traveling.<ref name="Scope"/> If Link asks how he knows this, the Old Man gives a cryptic answer about instinct, but he still encourages Link to try.<ref>{{Cite|[How do you know?] Experience, wisdom...instinct? Call it what you will and believe it only if you so please. Go ahead and take a look if you feel inclined to do so.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

The second time Link speaks to the Old Man on the Great Plateau Tower, he asks if he is having a difficult time locating Ancient Shrines.<ref>{{Cite|Having trouble finding the shrines?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link requests help, the Old Man suggests checking the [[System]] menu if he needs to review his abilities.<ref>{{Cite|[Help me out here.] I just remembered something that may help you. You can review some of the abilities you've learned on the pause screen.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He also repeats that Link can use the Scope <ref>{{Cite|If you're searching for shrines, use the {{Color BotW|Blue|scope}} on your {{Color BotW|Blue|Sheikah Slate}}.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

After this, the Old Man can be encountered at several locations throughout the Great Plateau. One of these places is the alcove near the Shrine of Resurrection. If Link speaks to him, the Old Man asks how his search for Ancient Shrines is going.<ref>{{Cite|So then... How goes your endeavor to explore the shrines?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> When asked what he is doing, he explains that he decides to sit by the Campfire because he felt cold.<ref>{{Cite|[What are you doing?] Oh... I was just feeling a chill. A warm fire can do wonders for a weary soul.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He also informs Link that he can sit by a Campfire to pass the time.<ref>{{Cite|A campfire is a wonderful place to pass the time. Staring into these flames, it's easy to lose track of the hours...|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Noticing that he was rambling, the Old Man says to ignore him, inviting Link to relax at the Campfire.<ref>{{Cite|Bah! Please ignore my ramblings. Feel free to relax here for as long as you'd like.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

Another place the Old Man can be found is the Old Man's Cabin, where he is [[Woodcutting]] using a Woodcutter's Axe. When Link approaches him, the Old Man will be pleased to see him again.<ref>{{Cite|Oho! Fancy that! So we meet again.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link inquires about what he is doing, he explains that he is gathering [[Wood]] to make a [[Fire]].<ref>{{Cite|[What are you doing?] I thought this tree here would make for some good firewood.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He then reveals that in order to make a [[Tree]] fall in a certain direction, Link should turn his hips so that they are facing where he wants it to land.<ref>{{Cite|However...getting a tree to fall exactly where you want it to is quite an art. The trick is to turn your hips so that they face where you want the tree to land.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Should Link have a Woodcutter's Axe, the Old Man asks him to try cutting down Trees, since he is getting tired.<ref>{{Cite|So... I see you found my axe. Why not help me out and give it a few swings? I'm working up quite a sweat here...but these bones could use a break.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link asks what he is doing a second time, the Old Man repeats that he is getting tired.<ref>{{Cite|[What are you doing?] I'm working up quite a sweat here... but these bones could use a break.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link does so, the Old Man will be grateful and allow him to take the Wood for himself.<ref>{{Cite|Oho! I see you did my work for me. Wonderful! Go ahead and take some of that wood for yourself. Don't be shy, now.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

Afterwards, the Old Man will walk over to the [[Cooking Pot]] in front of his Cabin and sit down. When Link speaks to him, he remarks that he does not find many things as delightful as a Campfire.<ref>{{Cite|Oho ho! There are few things as delightful as a roaring fire!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link asks what he is doing, the Old Man explains that at his age, it takes time to recover from working.<ref>{{Cite|[What are you doing?] This body of mine isn't what it used to be. Recovering from a boat of hard work takes a while...|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He tells Link that he can use the Cooking Pot to [[Cooking|Cook]] [[Food]] for himself.<ref>{{Cite|If you're hungry, I have an empty pot you can use to cook yourself a meal.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|If you're moved by any wild culinary inspiration, feel free to cook yourself a meal using my pot over there.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|My cooking pot is at your disposal. Feel free to make yourself something tasty whenever you feel the need.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Should Link ask the Old Man for Cooking tips, he tells him to toss [[Ingredient]]s into the Cooking Pot from his [[Inventory]].<ref>{{Cite|[Got any tips?] Simply open your inventory, grab hold of your ingredients, and toss them in!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He suggests putting thought into how Ingredients work together, sharing that there are meals that are capable of increasing one's [[Stamina]].<ref>{{Cite|Try to consider how the ingredients will complement one another. You can even make a dish that increases your stamina! It's all about being creative and trying different things. Oho ho!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

If Link has read ''[[The Old Man's Diary]]'', the Old Man will reveal at the end of their conversation that he knows.<ref>{{Cite|In case you were wondering, I know you were poking around in my diary.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He confirms that if Link is able to complete the recipe for [[Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry]], he will give him his [[Warm Doublet]] in return.<ref>{{Cite|That said, if you do end up figuring out how to create that dish I wrote about, my warm doublet is all yours.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> To find [[Raw Meat]], he suggests hunting in the [[Forest of Spirits]].<ref>{{Cite|If it's {{Color BotW|Blue|raw meat}} you're after, try hunting in the {{Color BotW|Blue|Forest of Spirits}}. You'll find it in the northern part of the plateau.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

When Link Cooks a meal, he has the option to show it to the Old Man.<ref>{{Cite|[I cooked something.] Hmm... Let's take a look at what you cooked up there, shall we?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link does so, the Old Man will comment on the quality of his Food.<ref>{{Cite|Not bad. Certainly not good... but not bad either.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link makes Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry, the Old Man will be shocked and ask what recipe he used.<ref>{{Cite|[I cooked something.] Wait... Is that... That looks just like my signature perfect dish, {{Color BotW|Blue|spicy meat and seafood fry}}! But how did you-?! Well, I suppose that is not important. Can I trouble you to share the recipe?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> After hearing the recipe, the Old Man is shocked that he forgot it included a [[Hyrule Bass]].<ref>{{Cite|Ah, of course! Hyrule bass! How could I have forgotten?|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He will then give Link his Warm Doublet.<ref>{{Cite|Well done! Now, please allow me to reward your culinary efforts with this warm doublet.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He explains that Link can use it to traverse [[Freezing Climate]]s, but he does not believe he will need it now that he has the recipe.<ref>{{Cite|With that, you will be able to resist the bite of colder environments. As for me, I know a great {{Color BotW|Blue|spicy meat and seafood fry}} recipe, so I can do without that warm doublet.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

After Link gives him the Spicy Meat and Seafood Fry, the Old Man writes about the event in his ''Diary''.<ref>{{Cite|To my surprise and delight, I did happen upon someone who was able to re-create my spicy meat and seafood fry. I gave him my {{Color BotW|Blue|warm doublet}}, and I was happy to do so. He is a fine young man with great potential, that one.|The Old Man's Diary|BotW}}</ref> He also copies down the recipe so that he does not forget it.<ref>{{Cite|Ah, and I will now write down this perfect recipe so that I will never forget it. Place some raw meat, spicy pepper, and hyrule bass in a pot, and then turn up the heat. Voilà!|The Old Man's Diary|BotW}}</ref> Next, he recounts that eating it allows him to walk around [[Mount Hylia]] without freezing, but he admits that he forgot that there was a time limit to it.<ref>{{Cite|Eating this dish allows you to walk the snowy mountains with ease, though I did forget there's a time limit on the effect.|The Old Man's Diary|BotW}}</ref> Due to this, he regrets giving away the Warm Doublet, which is able to keep someone warm indefinitely.<ref>{{Cite|It is too bad I already gave away that {{Color BotW|Blue|warm doublet}}, which keeps you warm no matter how long you wear it.|The Old Man's Diary|BotW}}</ref>

At midnight, the Old Man will retire to his Cabin. If Link asks what he is doing, the Old Man explains that he is tired and will be going to sleep in his [[Bed]].<ref>{{Cite|[What are you doing?] After a day like this, I'm exhausted. *ahem* I'm afraid I'll be needing my bed.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He welcomes Link to use his Bed whenever he is not asleep in it.<ref>{{Cite|You can use my bed if you ever need to rest for a bit. Well, assuming I'm not already in it, of course!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> While he is sleeping, Link can wake the Old Man up, which annoys him.<ref>{{Cite|What is it?! Just when I was finally able to fall asleep...|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link asks what he is doing, he responds that he was resting, and he tells Link to talk to him in the morning.<ref>{{Cite|[What are you doing?] Bah! Can't you tell when an old man is sound asleep? Let's talk in the morning.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

The Old Man also has a small campsite in the Forest of Spirits, where he attempts to hunt [[Woodland Boar]]s. If talked to, he will be pleased to see Link again.<ref>{{Cite|Well, well, well... So we meet again.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> When asked what he is doing, the Old Man states that he is hunting, and he tells Link to crouch down so he does not scare away his targets.<ref>{{Cite|[What are you doing?] Can you not see that I'm hunting here? You'll scare off my prey like that. At least crouch down a bit.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Should Link speaks to the Old Man again, he claims that hunting requires a lot of focus, since it keeps one's mind off of how much their back hurts.<ref>{{Cite|Hunting demands a great deal of focus... It keeps your mind off how much your back hurts from crouching all day.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> If Link ask if he has any tips, the Old Man suggests that Link crouch so that his prey does not notice him, at which point he should shoot it with an [[Arrow]].<ref>{{Cite|[Got any tips?] First, crouch down and approach your prey quietly to ensure you will not be noticed. When you're close enough that detection is nearly imminent...draw your bow and let your arrow fly!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> With proper aim, the Old Man states that Link should be able to take it down with a single shot.<ref>{{Cite|Aim thoughtfully, and you should be able to take down your prey with a single arrow.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Noticing how tired he is, the Old Man decides to take a break at his campsite.<ref>{{Cite|I am rather tired... Yes, I think I'm going to take a small break.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He allows Link to use this Cooking Pot as well, but Link must light the Campfire himself.<ref>{{Cite|Say, courageous one... Are you hungry? If so, please feel free to use my cooking pot to whip up a snack. If you need to start a fire, just light your torch on that campfire over there.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

The final location where Link can encounter the Old Man is on the southern peak of Mount Hylia, where he stands next to the [[King's Tomb]]. When Link approaches him, he remarks that he enjoys watching Hyrule from here.<ref>{{Cite|Ahhh... I enjoy gazing out at the world from here.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> After Link's response, the Old Man says that their current placement gives them the best view of the Great Plateau.<ref>{{Cite|[B-b-breathtaking view...] This may be the best place to get a full view of the entire plateau.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He then repeats his lesson on the Scope for Link.<ref name="Scope"/><ref>{{Cite|Use your {{Color BotW|Blue|scope}} to look for shrines. When you locate one, place a pin on your map as a marker.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> When Link asks how he knows this, the Old Man claims it was something he learned after living in the wild for so long.<ref>{{Cite|[How do you know?] Oho ho! Just a few tricks I've picked up after many, many years in the wild... You may take my advice or leave it. Go ahead and take a look if you feel inclined to do so. |Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

If Link has not yet obtained the Warm Doublet, the Old Man congratulates him and gives him the Warm Doublet as a reward.<ref>{{Cite|You did well to make it this far without the proper clothing. Please take this warm doublet as a reward for your tenacity.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He encourages Link to try it on, stating that it looks good when worn.<ref>{{Cite|I assume you will want to try it on right away, yes? I thought you might be eager to see how it looks... It's quite fetching! Well, I suppose it matters not. It is yours now. Do take care to put it on before you get too cold, though.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

After Link completes all four Ancient Shrines on the Great Plateau, the Old Man will glide towards him with the Paraglider one final time. He decides that it is now time for him to tell Link the truth.<ref>{{Cite|With this, you have now acquired all of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Spirit Orbs}} from the shrines on this plateau.|Old Man|BotW}}<br/>{{Cite|Oho ho! Extraordinary!|Old Man|BotW}}<br/>{{Cite|That means...it is finally time. Link, it is finally time for me to tell you everything. But first...|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He tells Link to imagine an "X" with the four Ancient Shrines are end points, and he directs him to go to the spot that would be where the lines intersect where he will be waiting.
<ref>{{Cite|Imagine an X on your map, with the four shrines as the end points. Find the spot {{Color BotW|Red|where those lines intersect}}. I shall wait for you there.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He then asks Link if he understands, repeating his words as he begins to disappear.<ref>{{Cite|Do you understand? Where two lines connecting the shrines would cross... There...I will...be waiting...|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> Once Link exchanges his [[Spirit Orb]]s at the [[Goddess Statue]] in the Temple of Time, the Old Man will call down to him from the roof. He notices that Link has become more resilient due to [[Hylia]]'s blessing.<ref>{{Cite|The blessing of the Goddess has made you that much more resilient, I see...|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> He then beckons for Link to join him on the roof.<ref>{{Cite|Here I am... Get up here—quickly!|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

When Link finally reaches the Old Man, he laughs and congratulates him for doing so well and admits that it is time to show Link his true identity.<ref>{{Cite|Well done there, young one! Now, then... The time has come to show you who I truly am.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref> The Old Man then reveals that his true identity: King Rhoam, the last ruler of Hyrule.<ref>{{Cite|I was King Rhoam Bosphoramus Hyrule. I was...the last leader of Hyrule. A kingdom which no longer exists.|Old Man|BotW}}</ref>

==Other Appearances==
{{Noncanon|Start}}
==={{BSTLoZ|-}}===
[[File:BSTLoZ Old Man Sprite.png|left|48px]]In {{BSTLoZ}}, various Old Men reprise their roles from {{TLoZ|-}}. The [[Player]] character automatically visits the [[Sword-Giving Old Man]] at the beginning of each week of gameplay, first to obtain the Wooden Sword, then to [[Saving|recall their progress]] in the subsequent weeks. At predetermined times throughout the adventure, an Old Man communicates telepathically with the Player, giving them valuable information and casting spells to aid them.
{{Clear}}
[[File:BSTLoZ Old Man Injured Sprite.png|left|48px]]With fifteen minutes remaining in the final week, the Sword-Giving Old Man is attacked by [[Ganon]] in his cave. The Player finds him face-down and injured, with a newly-created tunnel in the rear of the cave, leading to a room where Ganon can be battled if all eight [[Triforce]] pieces have been recovered. The Old Man recovers after Ganon is defeated.
{{Clear}}

==={{TSP|-}}===
[[File:Old Man (comic).png|thumb|right|100px|The Old Man in the {{ALttP|-}} comic]]
In {{TSP}}, Link can encounter mysterious Old Man if he chooses to take the [[Town of Ruto]] detour instead of going through the [[Midoro Swamp]] as he tries to reach the [[Water Town of Saria]]. Just as he is about to arrive to Ruto, he bumps into an Old Man, who gives the young hero a key.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=An old man with a long cane suddenly appears in the road in front of them. 'Just a humble townsman,' the man says. 'And a friend to you.' [...] The man shuffles forward, waving his cane. 'That's right, young fella!' He smiles, showing a row of crooked, yellow teeth. Then he reaches into his cloak and pulls out something that glimmers like gold. [...] The man places it in Link's hand.|book= TSP|publisher= |page= 69, 70}}</ref> The old man goes on to say that he shouldn't go through Ruto on his way to Saria since there is a traffic jam, and the old man disappears before Link can ask any questions.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote='A key!' he says with a wink. 'A key, that's what she is! Listen, take my advice and don't go through Ruto on your way to Saria. Terrible traffic jam in there.' Before Link can ask any more questions, the man turns and disappears into the tall grass by the roadside.|book= TSP|publisher= |page=70}}</ref>

==={{ALttP|-}} (Ishinomori)===
In the {{ALttP (Ishinomori)}}, an Old Man lives in the [[Sanctuary]], replacing the [[Loyal Sage]] from the game; however, he has a short role in the comic and only appears in the first chapter. [[Princess Zelda]], after being rescued, suggests to Link that they go to the Sanctuary and see the old man living there so that he may help them with their next move.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=We must escape and make our way to the Sanctuary!! The Old Man there will help us|book= ALttP (Ishinomori)|publisher= |page=13}}</ref> Upon reaching the Sanctuary, the Old Man explains the consequences of Agahnim's plan: if Agahnim succeeds in opening the way to the [[Dark World]] and breaking Ganon's seal, the King of Thieves would gather his army against Hyrule.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= Yes...and were he successful, the master of evil would marshal his forces against this world again!|book= ALttP (Ishinomori)|publisher= |page=14}}</ref> He then warns Link that he should not underestimate Agahnim if he is going to fight against him, since he can sense that an evil force is guiding the wizard's actions.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=Link? If you are going to battle the wizard Agahnim, do not underestimate him! I sense a powerful evil force is guiding his actions...|book= ALttP (Ishinomori)|publisher= |page= 15}}</ref> The Old Man is last seen in the comic after Princess Zelda is kidnapped by Agahnim in the Sanctuary. He tells Link to not worry about him and find the Master Sword since he is the only one who can defeat the evil wizard.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=Don't worry about me! Find the Master Sword! Link--it's up to you alone!|book= ALttP (Ishinomori)|publisher= |page=16}}</ref>
{{Clear}}

==={{SSBU|-}}===
The Old Man from {{BotW}} can occasionally be seen [[Paraglider|Paragliding]] in the background of the [[Great Plateau Tower]] Stage in {{SSBU}}. He can also be seen landing atop the Tower to watch the Fighters brawling.
{{Noncanon|End}}
